name: Trigger Mail For Supplier When RFQ getting Created
script:
if doc.doctype == "Request for Quotation": for supplier_row in doc.suppliers: supplier_info = frappe.db.get_value("Supplier", supplier_row.supplier, ["email_id", "supplier_name"], as_dict=True) if not supplier_info: continue supplier_email = supplier_info.email_id supplier_name = supplier_info.supplier_name or supplier_row.supplier if supplier_email: subject = f"New RFQ Created: {doc.name}" message = f"""

Dear {supplier_name},

A new Request for Quotation {doc.name} has been created and assigned to you.

Please review it at your earliest convenience.


Best regards,
Excellminds

""" frappe.sendmail(recipients=[supplier_email], subject=subject, message=message)
